results.title: Soft Transmission
results.overview: Partly eco-processed 8mm celluloid and tarot become a visual fascia, binding family through a shared fibromyalgia diagnosis and the mysticism of healing. Created in collaboration with the filmmaker’s aunt (a practicing medium), there is a resonance between their respective disciplines, where intuition, ritual, and material process converge. Like the experimental act of filmmaking itself, tarot opens up a lexicon for self-reflection, excavational storytelling, and embodied ways of knowing.

results.title: The Great Disgust
results.overview: When insects around the house grow increasingly aggressive, a young man’s controlling father releases a small frog to solve the problem.

results.title: Air
results.overview: A selection of memories, dreams, conversations from different places and of different people captured on Tri-X Super 8 film. Everything seems mixed and jumbled up, yet is unified through a dynamic soundscape. This is a film-diary that jumps through time and space, and finds connections between various sceneries and situations, which ordinarily would not find each other together. Made over the course of two years of accumulating footage and sound.

results.title: May 10th
results.overview: A little girl on her birthday is waiting for a boy to run around with sunflowers in his hands, and that's going to happen 10 years from now, and it could go on forever.

results.title: Acta de primavera
results.overview: Acta de primavera enters a public school in Madrid through the people who make it their daily world: students, teachers, and staff. Their perspectives form a collective portrait of school life, inviting us to listen closely to the experience of belonging to—and shaping—a shared institution.

results.title: If You Are Reading This...
results.overview: Cassandra travels to Philadelphia in search of her brother, but instead finds a phylactery she must destroy. Cosmic horror descends upon her as her mission is impeded by a crawling force dragging her into madness. As she begins to understand what is happening, she becomes a victim of the same celestial force that made her brother vanish. Trapped with nowhere to go, she is nevertheless on the path to solving the mystery.

results.title: GANGSTALKER!
results.overview: A young reptilian is sent to earth on a mission to hunt incels.

results.title: Flower Girl
results.overview: A man enters a barn where he encounters the Flower Girl, leading to his death.

results.title: Dessert
results.overview: When you work in the office, you have to keep an eye on your superiors.

results.title: Once in the Morning
results.overview: Consumed by everyday routine, the main character gradually stops noticing the beauty of everyday moments. But her son sees the world differently. His ability to imagine and dream, along with memories of her own childhood, help the woman rediscover joy in life and the beauty of the surrounding world.

results.title: The Dreamweaver
results.overview: High above in space, the Star Cat weaves a magical blanket from dreams each night, bringing children beautiful visions. But when a ravenous Rat begins gnawing at its glowing threads, dreams turn into nightmares. To restore light and peace, the Star Cat sets out to stop the intruder and protect the dreams of humankind.

results.title: Doomed by Choice
results.overview: A short animated film about a father who begins gambling, believing he is doing it for a better future for his family. But gradually, the game turns into an addiction, destroying his life, relationships, and his ability to control his own decisions.

results.title: Flower Shield
results.overview: A girl dreams of protection for people in Ukraine.

results.title: Echo
results.overview: An animated anthology of three interconnected stories about the consequences of war. Through the loss of home, loved ones, and a gradual fading of humanity, the film explores deep psychological traumas that echo in memory and transform one’s perception of the world and reality.

results.title: Rony's Adventure
results.overview: After Rony discovers a mysterious portal to the «Vault» and gains superpowers, he teams up with Alex and Jack to investigate the disappearance of his father, Tyler. Gradually, the friends uncover dangerous facts that link Rony’s magical abilities to events from the past.

results.title: Little Anteater
results.overview: The great journey of the Little Anteater.

results.title: Roaches in the Head
results.overview: In a student dormitory, beneath an old refrigerator, there is a city of cockroaches. When people decide to replace their refrigerator, their world is put at risk. Having overheard humans talk about their “inner gremlins,” King Roach decides it might as well be “inner cockroaches” and leads his people into the human mind in search of a new home.

results.title: Fatherhood
results.overview: Devoted soon-to-be father Lee grapples with work-family balance and self-doubt, but a surprising connection with a regular customer awakens a longing for the fatherly bond he never had.

results.title: A Doctor to Die For: The Sarah Harris Story
results.original_title: A Doctor to Die For: The Sarah Harris Story
results.overview: Sarah is drawn into a dangerous relationship with a middle-aged surgeon Dr. James Ryan. As Dr. Ryan secretly supplies her with surgical-grade drugs to keep her compliant and submissive, Sarah's life spirals out of control.
